About Pull n Push

More Than Just a Handle.

Pull n Push W.L.L. is a Bahrain-based door hardware company specializing in distinctive, high-quality architectural hardware. We work with a carefully selected network of local and international manufacturers and craftsmen, allowing us to source and develop products according to our own standards of quality, design, material and finish.

A distinctive detail that enhances the beauty of your home's entrance.

Curated QualityProducts selected according to design, material, finish and usability.
Custom OptionsSelected models support custom sizes and finish options on request.
Multiple MaterialsSolid brass, stainless steel, brass/steel, wood/steel and more depending on model.
Project SupportSuitable for residences, villas, hospitality and architectural projects.

Care Guide

Product Care

Care guidance for premium hardware finishes.

Clean using a soft dry cloth or a slightly damp cloth only. Avoid strong chemicals and abrasive cleaners. For brass products with a protective clear coating, professional re-polishing and re-coating can be carried out when required over time.
